tagline: One of Florida's largest community banks with $20.8B in assets
hero_kpi_rationale: Exceptional 28% growth in net interest income to $553.5M, reflecting organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, as well as a 34 basis point improvement in net interest margin

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from interest on loans and deposits
kpis.description: Net interest income increasing due to growth in loans and deposits
kpis.signal: Significant increase in net interest income

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net interest revenues relative to interest-earning assets
kpis.description: Net interest margin improving by 34 basis points to 3.58%, driven by lower deposit costs

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of the bank's assets
kpis.description: Total assets growing to $20.8 billion due to growth in loans, deposits, and acquisitions (VBI and Heartland)

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $0.65B in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.14B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents

kpis.name: Organic Loan Growth
kpis.description: Organic loan growth of 9% in 2025, reflecting the success of talent attraction program and expansion of commercial banking services

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has a large loan portfolio growing 22.6%, with exposure to borrower default risk, amplified by 9% organic growth and acquisitions

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate and asset price fluctuations. Securities portfolio growth is significant, with exposure to yield declines in a lower rate environment

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company benefits from a strong liquidity position with a loan-to-deposit ratio of 78%, well below prudential thresholds, and access to FHLB funding

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict banking regulations but maintains a solid capital position with a Tier 1 ratio of 14.5%

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company benefits from a long history since 1903 with an established presence in Florida. No major compliance issues mentioned

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive Florida market with a balanced growth strategy combining organic growth and strategic acquisitions

risks.title: Technology and Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on technology systems and online and mobile banking solutions, but no major security incidents are mentioned

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies was found in the SBCF 10-K document
